title: Phase 1 Validation: Live News Streaming Isolation
description:
Verify Live News streaming never mutates Brief queue state.

Test steps:
1. Add items to Brief queue, note current index/position
2. Go to Live News tab
3. Tap 'Play Live News' button
4. Confirm it plays immediately without adding episodes to Brief
5. Use next/prev - should navigate within stream list only
6. Stop playback or relaunch

Expected: Brief queue index/position unchanged by streaming.
